uploads.changelog:
siikk-Damage Numbers 1.4 – fix for WoW Forever

- Fixed: in WoW Forever the message "siikkSZ has been blocked" appeared at login. Like Midnight, Forever locks the combat log for addons; siikk no longer requests it there.
- In Forever (as in Midnight) siikk replaces the font of Blizzard's damage numbers (font and size under /sz). Own numbers with colors and crit glow are available in Anniversary and Classic.
